hints.title: Subarray Divisibility Pruning
hints.text: Every element in a valid subarray must be a multiple of k. If nums[i] % k does not equal 0, no valid subarray can contain it.

hints.title: Running GCD Accumulation
hints.text: For each starting index i, expand j rightward while computing cur_gcd = math.gcd(cur_gcd, nums[j]).

hints.title: Early Break on Non-Multiple
hints.text: If cur_gcd % k does not equal 0, break early because adding further elements cannot restore divisibility by k.

hints.title: Nested Subarray GCD Accumulator Implementation

complexity.notes: Iterates pairs of endpoints with fast GCD updates.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing full subarray GCD from scratch takes cubic O(n^3) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Accumulates GCD incrementally with early pruning when divisibility fails.
